summary_en: 840,000 ordinary shares (9.19% of shares outstanding before cancellation) cancelled effective 30 June 2026. Post-cancellation issued shares: 8,300,000; treasury shares: 30,547.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On 30 June 2026, Yagi & Co. completed the cancellation of 840,000 ordinary treasury shares, as resolved by the board on 11 May 2026 under Article 178 of the Companies Act (Japan). The cancelled shares represented 9.19% of the shares outstanding immediately before cancellation. Following the cancellation, issued shares total 8,300,000 and treasury shares held number 30,547.
